description.value: You program a ranged spell to split and hit two foes at once. If your next action is to Cast a Spell without a duration that requires an attack roll against a single target, you can choose a second target within range. You roll a single attack roll and compare the result to the AC of each target. This counts as one attack for your multiple attack penalty. To the second target, the spell deals only half the damage it would normally deal for its degree of success and has no effects beyond the spell's initial damage (such as imposing conditions or penalties).
